record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal z(N0), let S+ and S− be the forward and backward shifts on z(N0). If σΦ denotes the Φ-spectrum, determine whether the Φ-spectrum of each shift is exactly the annulus σΦ(S±|z) = { λ ∈ C : r(S∓|z)^−1 ≤ |λ| ≤ r(S±|z) }.

evidence.quote: The Φ-spectrum of an operator S ∈ L(X) is defined by σΦ(S|X) := { λ ∈ C : λI − S ∉ Φ(X) }.
Problem 4. Find out whether σΦ(S±|z) = { λ ∈ C : r(S∓|z)−1 ≤ |λ| ≤ r(S±|z) }.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ be a quasi-Banach sequence ideal on $\mathbb{N}_0 = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$; that is, $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb{C}^{\mathbb{N}_0}$ equipped with a complete quasi-norm such that $\ell_1 \subseteq z(\mathbb{N}_0) \subseteq \ell_\infty$ continuously, and $|x_n| \le |y_n|$ for all $n$ with $y \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ implies $x \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with $\|x\| \le \|y\|$. Assume further that $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is shift-monotone, i.e. both the forward shift
\[ S_+(\xi_0,\xi_1,\xi_2,\dots) := (0,\xi_0,\xi_1,\dots) \]
and the backward shift
\[ S_-(\xi_0,\xi_1,\xi_2,\dots) := (\xi_1,\xi_2,\xi_3,\dots) \]
act as bounded linear operators on $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$. For a bounded linear operator $T$ on a quasi-Banach space $X$, denote by $\Phi(X)$ the class of Fredholm operators on $X$ (those with closed range and finite-dimensional kernel and cokernel), and define the $\Phi$-spectrum
\[ \sigma_\Phi(T\,|\,X) := \{\lambda \in \mathbb{C} : \lambda I - T \notin \Phi(X)\}. \]
Let $r(T\,|\,X)$ denote the spectral radius of $T$ on $X$.

Determine whether
\[ \sigma_\Phi(S_\pm\,|\,z(\mathbb{N}_0)) = \bigl\{\lambda \in \mathbb{C} : r(S_\mp\,|\,z(\mathbb{N}_0))^{-1} \le |\lambda| \le r(S_\pm\,|\,z(\mathbb{N}_0))\bigr\}. \]
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in a survey on traces on operator ideals over Banach spaces. A web search did not return any subsequent work establishing or refuting the equality of the Φ-spectrum of the forward/backward shifts with the stated annulus on a general quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal, so the question appears to remain open.
